description:
Bastardcore is a chaotic internet aesthetic that originated on Tumblr approximately in the late 2010s, defined by a specific visual blend of low-fidelity "cursed images," youthful delinquency, and the dark, aggressive humor found in novelty T-shirts and internet memes. [ 1 ]

The aesthetic is often described by its followers as having a "rebel without a cause" or "feral" attitude, aiming to make viewers uncomfortable while simultaneously being "tastefully hilarious." [ 2 ] It is considered an extension of the broader "cursed image" meme, but is differentiated by its explicit focus on themes of mischief and anti-establishment irony. [ 1 ]

The movement is deliberately associated with edgelord humor and shock value, and users often state that the aesthetic is "supposed to strike your fight or flight response" by combining friendly or mundane imagery with unsettling, out-of-place elements. [ 2 ]
